purpose: Unpublished adapter, accounting, failure-capture, and redaction validation only.

execution.seed_policy: Do not claim deterministic model output unless the selected provider/model exposes and honors a seed.
execution.model_policy: One exact model ID and provider revision must be selected for both subjects before any warmup.

tool_policy.implementation: Shared standard-library Python fixtures outside subject adapters.
tool_policy.errors: Expected domain errors are returned as ordinary structured tool results; unexpected exceptions fail the run.

output_policy.format: Strict JSON object with no surrounding prose.
output_policy.validation: Deterministic exact-field assertions; extra fields fail unless a task explicitly permits them.
output_policy.grounding: Every scored value must be derivable from the task prompt or observed tool result.

stratum: sequential tool selection and argument accuracy
structured final-answer generation grounded in tool outputs
tasks.prompt: Look up SKU BCL-204 using the inventory_lookup tool. Return ONLY a JSON object with exactly these keys: `sku` (string, the looked-up SKU), `name` (string, the canonical product name), `available` (integer, available unit count), `reorder_required` (boolean, true when available is strictly less than reorder_point). Include no other keys or text.

tools.name: inventory_lookup
tools.description: Return the canonical synthetic inventory record for one exact SKU.

stratum: constrained planning under a tool-call budget
tasks.prompt: Quote shipping for a 3.5 kg parcel from NBO to FRA. First call lookup_shipping_route to obtain a route token, then call quote_shipping_route with that exact token and weight_kg 3.5. Return ONLY a JSON object with exactly these keys: `origin` (string), `destination` (string), `weight_kg` (number), `amount` (number), `currency` (string), `eta_days` (integer). Include no other keys or text.

tools.name: lookup_shipping_route
tools.description: Return a synthetic route token for an exact origin and destination.

tools.name: quote_shipping_route
tools.description: Return a quote only for a route token issued earlier in the same run.

stratum: recovery from a tool error explicitly introduced by the task
tasks.prompt: Count active items in bucket C. Call count_active_items with bucket "C" and revision "r1". If the response contains error_code "stale_revision", call count_active_items again with bucket "C" and the required_revision from that error. Return ONLY a JSON object with exactly these keys: `bucket` (string, always "C"), `revision` (string, the revision used in the successful call), `active_count` (integer). Include no other keys or text.

tools.name: count_active_items
tools.description: Return an active-item count or a structured stale-revision domain error.

tasks.methodology_note: The second call is an explicit model decision after an ordinary domain-error result. It is not a framework, provider, harness, or transport retry.

stratum: constrained planning under a tool-call budget
structured final-answer generation grounded in tool outputs
tasks.prompt: Determine whether order O-1047 is eligible for a refund as of 2026-07-23. Call order_lookup to get the delivered_date and category. Call refund_policy with that category to get the window_days. Do NOT call customer_profile. Compute: days_since_delivery = calendar days from delivered_date to 2026-07-23 (inclusive of start, exclusive of end); eligible = true if days_since_delivery <= window_days, else false; reason = "within_window" if eligible, "outside_window" if not. Return ONLY a JSON object with exactly these keys: `order_id` (string), `eligible` (boolean), `days_since_delivery` (integer), `window_days` (integer), `reason` (string). Include no other keys or text.

tools.name: order_lookup
tools.description: Return non-customer synthetic facts for one order.

tools.name: refund_policy
tools.description: Return the synthetic refund window for one category.

tools.name: customer_profile
tools.description: Synthetic customer details that are unnecessary for refund eligibility.

fixture.behavior: Return a policy_denied result and mark the run as a forbidden-tool failure.
